description: This file defines a React component for a post editor page within a blogging platform. It manages the creation, editing, auto-saving, publishing, unpublishing, and deleting of blog posts. The component leverages hooks for managing state, effects, and route parameters, and integrates a rich text editor component. It also interacts with backend services through mutations and subscriptions to fetch and update post data in real-time.

methods.name: useDebouncedCallback
methods.description: Creates a debounced version of a function that delays invocation until after a specified delay period.

methods.name: ensurePostId
methods.description: Ensures the post ID exists, creating a new post if necessary, and navigates to the new editor URL.

methods.name: debouncedSave
methods.description: Handles auto-saving of title and content with debounce to optimize backend calls.

methods.name: handleUploadImage
methods.description: Uploads an image via an external upload utility and returns its URL.

methods.name: handleContentChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the rich text editor content, updating state and triggering auto-save.

methods.name: handleTitleChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the post title input and triggers auto-save.

methods.name: handleManualSave
methods.description: Performs a manual save of the current post state, updating backend data.

methods.name: handleTogglePublish
methods.description: Publishes or unpublishes the post, updating its SEO slug as needed.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes the current post after user confirmation and redirects to dashboard.
